review.note: Retracted in M21: 22 July 1951, five years early because Óscar Carmona had died on 18 April. It produced Craveiro Lopes, and nothing the atlas holds follows from it. The presidency of the Estado Novo is in the atlas by way of 1928, when it was made, and 1958, when it was taken away from the electorate.
